messages:
release-coordinator: Heads-up — code freeze starts in ~24h for v1.8.0. There will be a 2-hour SLO-grace window during cutover where low-risk ops changes are allowed. If you need a post-cutoff change, request a freeze-exception with: short justification, test plan, and explicit rollback steps.

maya: ack. Quick Q — does the grace window allow autoscaling to spin up dedicated nodes for throughput tests?

jordan: yes autoscaling is allowed for capacity, but please do NOT ship new model artifacts or weight changes during the grace. Config toggles only.

gabe: FYI I have a tiny docs PR (no runtime changes) — opened #5421 and added the `freeze-exception` label per instructions. pinging @eloise for QA.

eloise: thanks — grabbing it now. If acceptance tests pass I'll +1 and note the time.

jordan: reminder: update CHANGELOG.md with a one-line summary (author + terse note). Small non-runtime PRs can still land during grace if they have an approved `freeze-exception`.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 03:00 UTC. Rollback window: 30m after canary. Rollback command: `scripts/deploy rollback --release v1.8.0 --to-tag v1.7.9`

release-coordinator: Important — any exception approved must include either (a) a revert PR pre-created and linked, or (b) exact deploy rollback commands documented in the PR description. No rollback = high chance of denial.

maya: added rollback steps and a short perf run to PR #5421. Also included expected token-per-second impact. @release-approvers please review.

jordan: CI note — our gating enforces the `freeze-exception` label after cutoff; merges without it will be blocked.

eloise: QA +1 (acceptance passed on staging, logs looked clean).

gabe: merging docs PR now per approvals.

release-coordinator: thanks all. Final cutoff is at 2169999999 (root ts). If you requested an exception, please confirm approval thread here and drop the rollback link. I'll track approvals and post final status 30m before cutoff. :white_check_mark:
